say:1:1530115001:0.text: I am. Wildborn warriors are all fine hunters.
say:1:1530115001:0.source_cn: 当然，雅库伯尔的战士都是好猎手。
say:1:1530115001:0.male: I am. Wildborn warriors are all fine hunters.
say:1:1530115001:0.female: I am. Wildborn warriors are all fine hunters.

say:2:1530115002:0.text: But there are so many mouths to feed in Wrathwood Grove.
say:2:1530115002:0.source_cn: 但是树怒山谷里人很多，需要很多猎物才能吃饱。
say:2:1530115002:0.male: But there are so many mouths to feed in Wrathwood Grove.
say:2:1530115002:0.female: But there are so many mouths to feed in Wrathwood Grove.

say:3:1530115003:0.text: We need bigger prey, or people will starve.
say:3:1530115003:0.source_cn: 所以猎手必须尝试狩猎更大的野兽，才能填饱大家的肚子。
say:3:1530115003:0.male: We need bigger prey, or people will starve.
say:3:1530115003:0.female: We need bigger prey, or people will starve.

say:4:1530115004:0.text: Only with the blessing of the Wild Moon can we face those great beasts and survive!
say:4:1530115004:0.source_cn: 面对野兽，只有雅库伯尔之月的赐福，才能庇佑我们！
say:4:1530115004:0.male: Only with the blessing of the Wild Moon can we face those great beasts and survive!
say:4:1530115004:0.female: Only with the blessing of the Wild Moon can we face those great beasts and survive!
